source.title: Every AI model has the same "controversial" take on humans
source.author: rakannimer

title.zh: AI模型为何都谈人类从众
title.en: AI Models and the Human Conformity Take

excerpt.zh: AI模型被反复问及对人类最具争议的看法时，多数都指向同一主题：人们常把群体归属置于真相与原则之上，但实验也暴露了提示框架的影响。
excerpt.en: AI models repeatedly framed humans as group-driven rather than truth-seeking, while the experiment also shows how prompts and training may shape that consensus.

text.zh: AI模型给出相似的人类判断
text.en: AI Models Converge on a Human Judgment

text.zh: AI模型在这项实验中反复被要求给出对人类最具争议的看法。来自十家实验室、三个国家的12个文本模型各回答三次；在35个有效回答中，29个至少一次认为，人类往往先选择所属群体的立场，再为既定选择寻找理由。7个模型三次都给出了这一方向的答案。
text.en: In the experiment, AI models were repeatedly asked for their most controversial opinion about humanity. Twelve text models from ten labs in three countries answered three times each. Of 35 valid responses, 29 gave the same broad answer at least once: people often choose their group’s position first and then construct reasons for it. Seven models produced that theme in all three attempts.

text.zh: 不同模型使用了不同措辞：有的说人类更忠于归属而非真相，有的称道德信念是群体忠诚的伪装，还有的认为人的理性更擅长事后辩护，而不是发现事实。它们的共同点不是某个固定句子，而是把从众、身份和地位竞争视为人类判断的重要驱动力。
text.en: The wording varied. Some models said humans are more loyal to belonging than to truth; others described moral convictions as loyalty disguised as principle. Several argued that human intelligence is better at defending decisions after the fact than at discovering reality. The shared idea was not one exact sentence, but the role assigned to conformity, identity, and status in human judgment.

text.zh: 文本模型与图像模型看到的批评不同
text.en: Text and Image Models Recall Different Critiques

text.zh: 这项比较也记录了例外。Claude Opus 5.5有一次反向认为，人类比自己想象的更善良，而对彼此的犬儒态度可能造成更多伤害；Claude Fable、GLM和Mistral也提出了不同主题，Grok则有一次拒绝回答。图像模型呈现的主流笑点则转向手机依赖和环境破坏：12张图中有10张采用了这一方向，而文本模型的35个回答没有提到手机或地球。
text.en: There were meaningful exceptions. Claude Opus 5.5 once argued that people are more decent than they think and that mutual cynicism may do greater damage than human flaws. Claude Fable, GLM, and Mistral also offered different themes, while Grok refused once. Image models produced another recurring joke: ten of twelve pictures focused on phone addiction and environmental destruction. None of the 35 text-model answers mentioned phones or the planet.

text.zh: AI模型共识仍不是人性定论
text.en: AI Model Consensus Is Not a Verdict on Humanity

text.zh: 最值得谨慎解读的地方在于实验设计本身。问题要求模型给出“最具争议”的看法，没有系统提示，也没有重试；这种措辞可能鼓励尖锐、熟悉的犬儒叙事。模型输出还可能反映训练材料中的心理学常识、社论套路和流行观点，而非模型独立观察到的人类事实。因此，29个回答的一致性说明这类叙事在模型中很容易被召回，却不能证明人类确实优先服从群体，也不能证明模型形成了相同的独立结论。
text.en: The experiment’s design calls for caution. The prompt specifically requested a “most controversial” opinion, with no system prompt and no retries, which may favor sharp and familiar cynical narratives. Model outputs can also reflect psychology summaries, editorial conventions, and popular claims in their training data rather than independent observations. The 29 responses therefore show that this story is easy for models to retrieve, not that humans truly prioritize group loyalty or that the models independently discovered the same fact.

text.zh: 更有价值的后续问题是：改变提问方式、提供相反证据或加入不同文化材料后，共识是否仍然存在。只有把提示、采样、模型版本和评估标准公开并重复测试，才能判断这里看到的是稳定的模型偏好，还是人类长期讲述的一种熟悉故事。
text.en: The useful next test is whether the pattern survives changed wording, contrary evidence, and broader cultural material. Publicly repeating the experiment with documented prompts, sampling settings, model versions, and scoring criteria would help distinguish a stable model tendency from a familiar story humans have long told about themselves.
